Rule.Name: RxdkXboxBuild
Rule.Description: Compile/build settings for the Xbox title.

EnumProperty.Name: RxdkBuildFlavor
EnumProperty.Description: Whether this configuration builds Debug (unoptimized -O0, debug info, debug SDK libs) or Release (optimized, release SDK libs). Defaults from the configuration name; set it explicitly for a custom configuration.

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkIncrementalBuild
BoolProperty.Description: Recompile only the sources whose object is out of date (older than the source or a header it includes, tracked via depfiles), and skip the link/image/ISO steps when nothing changed. On by default. Rebuild and Clean still force a full from-scratch build. Set to false to always recompile every source.

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkExceptions
BoolProperty.Description: Compile C++ sources with exception support (-fexceptions). On by default — RXDK's C++ runtime supports real DWARF exceptions on the console. Set to false (-fno-exceptions) to drop the EH tables when a title never throws.

EnumProperty.Name: RxdkCppStandard
EnumProperty.Description: The C++ language standard (-std) for this project's C++ sources. RXDK's libc++ gates C++20/23 features on the standard, so pick the one your code needs.

StringListProperty.Name: PreprocessorDefinitions
StringListProperty.Description: Extra preprocessor macros passed to the compiler (in addition to the built-in _XBOX;XBOX). One per entry, e.g. MY_FLAG or NAME=VALUE.

StringListProperty.Name: AdditionalIncludeDirectories
StringListProperty.Description: Extra project-relative directories searched for #include headers (added after sdk\include), e.g. src or third_party\include.

StringListProperty.Name: RxdkPublicIncludePaths
StringListProperty.Description: For library projects: include directories exported to projects that reference this one (also usable locally). e.g. include.

StringListProperty.Name: AdditionalDependencies
StringListProperty.Description: SDK libraries linked into the title, by exact filename including .lib — like a real Additional Dependencies list, nothing is appended automatically (order matters; libkernel.lib is forced last automatically). e.g. libd3d8.lib;libd3dx8.lib;libxapi.lib;libc.lib;libcpp.lib;libkernel.lib;libcompat.lib.

StringListProperty.Name: AdditionalLibraryDirectories
StringListProperty.Description: Extra directories to resolve Additional Dependencies names from, searched after the SDK lib dir (project-relative or absolute). For linking your own prebuilt .lib by name.

StringListProperty.Name: RxdkAdditionalLibraries
StringListProperty.Description: Explicit prebuilt static-library files to link, by path (project-relative or absolute .lib), in addition to the named Additional Dependencies above. For a third-party .lib that isn't part of the SDK.

StringProperty.Name: RxdkPreBuildEvent
StringProperty.Description: Command line run before the build (cmd script; MSBuild macros allowed).

StringProperty.Name: RxdkPostBuildEvent
StringProperty.Description: Command line run after a successful build (cmd script; MSBuild macros allowed).
